experiment.name: phase9_procedural_transfer_recovery_v2_1_1
experiment.primary_failure: v2.1 recovery training improved collision challenge cases but overwrote a strong query-aware original DEV path
experiment.primary_objective: Preserve the original student's query-aware Real-RAG quality while learning only residual procedural binding failures.
experiment.interpretation_of_v21: Query-aware retrieval is the main fix for the historical 0/150 collapse; weight training is optional residual repair and must earn its preservation cost.

retrieval.reason: v2.1 same-weight DEV result recovered most original procedural correctness without changing model weights

training.strategy: bounded early-stopping ladder; not a hyperparameter sweep

stage_a.name: short_binding_burst
stage_a.purpose: briefly teach exact evidence binding on residual hard collisions

stage_b1.name: preservation_first_consolidation_1
stage_b1.purpose: consolidate with a replay-dominated mixture while minimizing drift

stage_b2.name: preservation_first_consolidation_2
stage_b2.purpose: optional second micro-consolidation checkpoint so selection can stop before overtraining

safety_guard.reason: prevent accidental repetition of aggressive long-run recovery that can overwrite the query-aware baseline

evaluation.sealed_test_policy: Freeze one DEV-selected candidate first. Sealed TEST never trains or recalibrates.

selection.decision_rule: Choose a technically valid trained candidate only when its positive challenge gain exceeds its weighted relative preservation cost. Otherwise keep candidate zero.
selection.quality_improvement_policy: Improvements reduce a metric's loss to zero; they do not create negative loss that can hide regressions elsewhere.
selection.sensitivity_policy: Report both balanced and preservation-guarded selections. If they disagree, require human review rather than silently promoting a fragile checkpoint.

downstream.student_optimization_v2: blocked until v2.1.1 DEV selection is reviewed and the chosen path preserves the query-aware baseline
downstream.mass_retraining_other_students: defer until this fixed recipe demonstrates a useful trained candidate or establishes query-aware-only as the better policy
